record.question: If you live in a corrupt society, you cannot easily rise __________ the prevailing norm.
record.explanation: The natural expression is “rise above” a norm: to transcend or behave better than the standard around you. Thus the answer is C, above. Verified solution; unofficial, because no final official key is registered for this paper.
